label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: The Skip to main content link did nothing visible: after pressing Enter focus was reset to the top of the page and the next Tab landed on a video, so the skip link did not help.
Several Tab stops have no name, for example an unnamed link on the product card, an unnamed icon button after adding to basket, and unnamed videos, so I could not tell what they were.

After pressing Add to basket nothing announced that the item was added; the button simply vanished and focus sat on an unnamed button. I only learned it worked when a basket drawer appeared after the next Tab.
The basket drawer puts about 25 upsell Tab stops (links, add buttons, size lists) between the item and the CHECKOUT button; Escape did not close it, and reaching Checkout took roughly 27 Tab presses.

After choosing guest checkout the page went blank for a moment with no title, then loaded. On the checkout page the form fields come after the order summary in Tab order, and the three step panels are focusable blocks with no inner fields, so for several Tab presses I could not find any input. The delivery panel also already showed an outside our shipping zone error before I had entered an address.

The address search field has no label and its results arrive late: first No results found was shown, then a list of suggestions appeared. The phone hint about numeric characters only appeared after I typed. Enter address manually and Continue to delivery could not be reached by Tab, so I could not finish the address step.
